Baked Chicken Thighs
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 24, 2009 - 12:52am

Ingredients




1 cup butter
12 chicken thighs
1 cup flour
2 teaspoons salt
1/2 teaspoon pepper
2 teaspoons paprika
1 recipe sauce
1 sm. clove garlic, grated
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 cup salad oil
1/2 cup lemon juice
3 tablespoons onion, chopped
1/2 teaspoon pepper
1/2 teaspoon thyme

Preparation

1 Heat butter in skillet. Shake the chicken thighs in mixture of flour, salt, pepper and paprika. Arrange chicken in skillet, skin side down and fry to golden brown. Transfer chicken to baking dish. Cover with sauce. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. 2 Blend and let stand several hours before using.
